watchful.cue: keeps glancing toward the exit; its attacks become cautious.

confident.cue: raises its chin and challenges you; its attacks become firmer.

calm.cue: lowers its guard, giving you breathing room.

slime.cue: copies your stance, leaving more room between attacks.

bandit.cue: gestures at your purse: a fair cut might end this. Its blade slows.

snake.cue: asks what brought you here, pausing between strikes.

rock.cue: asks for quiet; its heavy movements grow drowsy.

dragon.cue: yawns, then dares you to stand your ground. Its attacks grow firmer.
